options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of members to be retrieved. If not specified, the default is 500. The maximum allowed limit is 500.

options.name: memberAssociationType
options.description: MemberAssociationType query parameter. Indicates how the member is associated with the tag. Possible values and description. 1) DYNAMIC The member is associated to the tag through rules. 2) STATIC – The member is associated to the tag manually. 3) MIXED – The member is associated manually and also satisfies the rule defined for the tag.

options.name: memberType
options.description: MemberType query parameter. Entity type of the member. Possible values can be retrieved by using /tag/member/type API.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. Used for pagination. It indicates the starting row number out of available member records.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
